Thanks for signing up for the Hosted API evaluation — really excited to see what you
build. I’m Marissa on the Growth/Sales team at Redwood. Would love to schedule a quick
30-minute demo to walk through:

- How the Hosted API works for evaluation workflows (keys, rate limits, quickstart)
- Typical integration patterns (prefetching, caching, batching)
- Performance and cost considerations for a docs ingestion workload
- SOC 2 / security and next steps for procurement

Are you available for 30 minutes this week? I’m proposing:
- Wed Mar 11, 11:00 AM ET (8:00 AM PT)
- Wed Mar 11, 2:00 PM ET (11:00 AM PT)

If neither works, send a slot that does and I’ll update the invite.

I’m including Marcus (AE) on the thread to join the call and Soojin (Solutions Eng) in case we need to dig into any API specifics. I’ve attached a short demo deck for context.

Attachment: hosted-api-demo-deck.pdf (3 slides)

Thanks,
